SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE ROLE_CODE = 'USER' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS USER_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED') AS BUSINESS_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL WHERE REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED') AS TRIAL_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRIAL_INQUIRY) AS INQUIRY_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION WHERE PLAN_TYPE = 'PREMIUM' AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR END_DATE > SYSDATE)) AS PREMIUM_BUSINESS_COUNT,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT WHERE STATUS = 'PAID' AND PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)) AS MONTH_REVENUE,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING') AS PENDING_BUSINESS_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND APPROVED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND APPROVED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)) AS APPROVED_BUSINESS_MONTH_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'PENDING') AS PENDING_TRIAL_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'REJECTED' AND UPDATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND UPDATED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1)) AS REJECTED_TRIAL_MONTH_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT L.REVIEW_LOG_NO, TO_CHAR(L.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT_TEXT, L.TARGET_TYPE, L.TARGET_NO, CASE L.TARGET_TYPE WHEN 'BUSINESS' THEN ( SELECT B.ORG_NAME FROM BUSINESS B WHERE B.BUSINESS_NO = L.TARGET_NO ) WHEN 'TRIAL' THEN ( SELECT T.TITLE FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = L.TARGET_NO ) WHEN 'PROMOTION' THEN ( SELECT T.TITLE FROM TRIAL_PROMOTION P JOIN CLINICAL_TRIAL T ON T.TRIAL_NO = P.TRIAL_NO WHERE P.PROMOTION_NO = L.TARGET_NO ) WHEN 'SUBSCRIPTION' THEN ( SELECT B.ORG_NAME FROM BUSINESS_SUBSCRIPTION S JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = S.BUSINESS_NO WHERE S.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = L.TARGET_NO ) ELSE NULL END AS TARGET_NAME, L.ACTION_TYPE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS ADMIN_NAME FROM ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG L JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = L.ADMIN_MEMBER_NO ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC, L.REVIEW_LOG_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
